tagline: Leading zero-carbon energy provider through nuclear generation and state-sponsored programs
hero_kpi_rationale: Nuclear PTC revenue represents a structural and growing government revenue stream for eligible nuclear plants, reflecting federal policy support for decarbonized energy through 2032
company_description: Constellation Energy Corporation produces and sells energy products and services in the United States. The company operates through five segments: Mid-Atlantic, Midwest, New York, ERCOT, and Other Power Regions. It offers electricity, natural gas, energy-related products, and sustainable solutions. The company has approximately 31,676 megawatts of generating capacity consisting of nuclear, wind, solar, natural gas, and hydroelectric assets. It serves distribution utilities, municipalities, cooperatives, and commercial, industrial, public sector, and residential customers. The company was incorporated in 2021 and is headquartered in Baltimore, Maryland.

risks.summary: The company is exposed to credit risks related to counterparty non-performance.
risks.score_rationale: The company faces credit risks from counterparty non-performance, which could result in significant financial losses. The company has nuclear fuel supply contracts with Russian counterparties, which could be affected by economic sanctions. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.summary: The company is subject to strict regulations regarding nuclear safety and environmental protection.
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations on nuclear safety and environmental protection, and regulatory changes could negatively impact financial results. The company must comply with requirements from the NRC and other regulatory bodies. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Liquidity Risks
risks.summary: The company could face liquidity risks if it is unable to finance its operations and investments.
risks.score_rationale: The company could face liquidity risks if it cannot finance its operations and investments. Although the company has $7.4 billion of available capacity under its credit facilities and $3.6 billion in cash, significant acquisitions such as the Calpine transaction create substantial financing needs. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Nuclear Decommissioning Risks
risks.summary: The company is responsible for decommissioning its nuclear plants, which could result in significant costs and environmental risks.
risks.score_rationale: The company is responsible for decommissioning its nuclear plants, representing an asset retirement obligation of $12.9 billion as of December 31, 2025. Future costs depend on complex probabilistic models, cost escalation factors, and discount rates. (default score, to be refined)
